proven_control.description: A V3 research worker accepts a work item only when its content-addressed SampledSlotIdentity is issued from the frozen registry and exactly matches release package, slot, business, hostname, runtime and work-item ID.

evidence: FrozenPhaseOneSampleRegistry.issue(work_item_id, slot_number) is present only in the research-worker library and tests.
ResearchApplicationService.start_run creates a ResearchRun without sampled_slot_identity.
The production Phase 1 image contains research and intelligence workers but no bounded Slot 01 work-item activation command.
No Phase 1 API or other deployed component creates a registry-derived sampled-slot work item.
The three ECS services are consumers only and remain desired/running/pending 0/0/0.
defect.effect: A live release and service scale-up could not create an executable, V3-valid Slot 01 run. An ordinary run would be rejected before DNS, so issuing REAL_PUBLIC_RESEARCH now would be non-executable and misleading.

additional_chain_observation.detail: The deterministic M2-M5 worker consumes queued predecessor operations but the deployed runtime has no release-bound coordinator that creates the initial sampled M1 work item and advances only from accepted predecessor artifacts. The successor must preserve truthful terminal stops and must not auto-approve human review states.

requirements: Add one bounded production activation command that reads the current exact release and frozen slot registry, derives an immutable work-item ID and SampledSlotIdentity, verifies the complete binding, and creates exactly one idempotent Slot 01 business/research work item.
Run that command only as a separately authorized one-off task; no arbitrary caller slot identity and no arbitrary code override.
Add deterministic stage coordination that queues a downstream stage only from an accepted terminal predecessor artifact and stops at every human-review or truthful terminal state.
Bind activation to the same release window, request/byte/cost ceilings, kill switch, runtime digest and terminal rollback.
Prove no release, malformed release, wrong slot/package/business/host, expired release and TRIPPED kill switch all create zero work items and zero DNS calls.
Publish, scan, cryptographically bind and deploy a successor image under separate exact owner approvals.
prohibited_shortcuts: direct database insertion from an unbound operator session
python -c or other arbitrary-code ECS override
using the identity-less ordinary API run
creating a release before an executable activation path is deployed
